title: Fluid Speech versus the Pageborne ensemble

host.cpu: NVIDIA GB10 Grace ARM64, shared host

protocol: Replay all 221 human-transcribed constituent LibriSpeech clips from the frozen 15-speaker expanded-window study, without selecting by candidate errors.
Same PCM16 mono 16kHz files; WAV SHA-256 matches frozen manifest. References only used in scoring, never model prompts.
Production 0.1.19 Conformer, Zipformer and Moonshine in Chromium/WASM with one inference thread; sequential models per clip.

Baseline transcribes clips up to 15 seconds in one pass, and 17 longer clips via production SpeechStream with 15-second windows and 7.5-second overlap. This is completed-recording decoding, not paced microphone streaming.
Separate existing-model no-dictionary and saved disjoint same-chapter dictionary conditions. Fluid decoders have no hints; ensemble voting uses same dictionary in hinted condition.
Fluid Speech Mini ONNX packed 2/4-bit and Fluid Speech Pro ONNX int8 run via native ONNX Runtime CPU, one thread, greedy decoding, clean mode off. All public clips fit one pass.

Mini official Python implementation and onnx-asr Pro; instrumentation observes token posterior without altering token selection. Word confidence is minimum overlapping token probability, matching production default.
Fixed-order production voteSpeech across all 31 nonempty subsets; raw uncalibrated confidences and uniform-vote sensitivity control. No confidence tuning on evaluation references.
Micro-averaged WER after whisper-normalizer 1.0.1 EnglishTextNormalizer; standalone plus ensembles scored identically.
Speaker-cluster paired bootstrap, 5000 resamples seeded 20261119, exploratory evidence; historical selection corpus is not independent of earlier ensemble development.

Private Ask recordings have no verified references. Only transcript agreement/behavior evaluated, never scored as accuracy. Saved baseline was captured live; Fluid replay was offline with longer bounded windows, so comparisons are diagnostic.

Timing is full-clip warm decoding on shared desktop, not physical iPhone or end-of-speech latency. Native Fluid and browser baseline timings are distinct runtime categories. Accuracy runs were concurrent independent CPU jobs; browser compatibility probe uses precomputed official acoustic features.
Model changes have not been deployed; private audio/transcripts stay in protected local evaluation directory.

supplement.selection: 50 turn indices per meeting, round(i*(N-1)/49) for i=0..49, preserving all selected lexical turns including short fillers; fixed before candidate inference on this subset

harnessNotes: The Pro confidence adapter initially stopped on a spacing contraction (use apostrophe em). Character mapping was fixed to follow the unchanged rendered text; the stopped case was rerun and retained. No candidate transcripts were edited.
AMI sampling was fixed before inference on that subset; all 200 selected turns are retained.
Both native models passed three silent inputs of 1, 5 and 15 seconds.

results.normalization: whisper-normalizer 1.0.1 EnglishTextNormalizer; words pooled, not mean utterance WER
